0.1.2.en: Stability fixes (improved error handling and logging)

0.1.3.en: Add code quality tooling and development workflow improvements

0.1.5.en: Fixed the 'Endpoint state changed' flow trigger, fixed endpoint autocomplete when multiple panels are paired, faster and quieter startup

0.1.6.en: Verify endpoint types against the live panel (fixes endpoints mis-typed by the factory-layout interview); stop showing fabricated blind state.

0.2.0.en: Blinds now use proper up/stop/down controls instead of a dimmer slider, with new Open, Close, Stop and 'Blind moved' flow cards and a configurable travel time. Paired panels migrate automatically. The old dimmer flow cards are deprecated.
